versions.changelog: Detect open PRs from fetched issue links and cross-reference timelines; live-recheck final recommendations when link coverage is partial.
Restrict GitHub tooling to read-only list and view commands, narrow activation, and keep issue analysis inside the configured agent runtime.
Add --topic, --search, and --label options for targeted issue fetching. Enables filtering by component (e.g. telegram, agents) instead of only analyzing the most recent issues.
Declare GitHub CLI (gh) as required dependency

Post-review fixes: trimmed frontmatter, fixed multiplier tables, improved suggestedLevel criteria, added missing field handling, clarified --include-with-prs, consistent detection labels, LLM integration guidance
Initial release: GitHub issue analysis with ROI scoring, Tripping Scale, Architectural Impact, Actionability, PR dedup, and contributor level matching
